import pandas as pd
pd.set_option("display.width", 200); pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 40)

N, QUORUM = 5, 5 // 2 + 1

class ReplicaV2:
    def __init__(self, rid):
        self.rid = rid
        self.up = True
        self.epoch = 0
        self.voted_for = None
        self.role = "follower"
        self.leader = None
        self.log = []              # entry = {"epoch", "index", "value"}
        self.commit_index = 0
        self.applied_index = 0
        self.truncations = 0       # audit: how often this replica rewound

    @property
    def last_log_index(self):
        return len(self.log)

    def append_entries(self, epoch, leader, entries, leader_commit):
        """Reconcile by index: truncate on conflict, then append the tail."""
        if not self.up or epoch < self.epoch:
            return False
        self.epoch = epoch
        self.heartbeat(leader)
        for e in entries:
            i = e["index"]
            if i <= len(self.log):
                if self.log[i - 1] != e:                 # conflict -> rewind
                    self.log = self.log[: i - 1]
                    self.truncations += 1
                    self.log.append(e)
            else:
                self.log.append(e)
        if leader_commit > self.commit_index:
            self.commit_index = min(leader_commit, self.last_log_index)
        return True

    def heartbeat(self, leader):
        self.leader, self.role = leader, "follower"

    def apply(self):
        self.applied_index = self.commit_index


class LedgerClusterV2:
    def __init__(self, n=N):
        self.replicas = [ReplicaV2(i) for i in range(n)]
        self.epoch, self.leader = 0, None
        self.log, self.commit_index, self.applied_index = [], 0, 0
        self.events, self.timeline = [], []

    def up(self):
        return [r for r in self.replicas if r.up]

    def _ev(self, kind, detail):
        self.events.append(dict(epoch=self.epoch,
                                leader=None if self.leader is None else f"r{self.leader}",
                                event=kind, detail=detail))

    def snapshot(self, phase):
        row = dict(phase=phase, epoch=self.epoch,
                   leader=None if self.leader is None else f"r{self.leader}",
                   quorum_size=QUORUM, replicas_up=len(self.up()),
                   log_last_index=len(self.log),
                   max_replica_log=max(r.last_log_index for r in self.replicas),
                   commit_index=self.commit_index,
                   applied_index=self.applied_index,
                   quorum_at_commit=sum(1 for r in self.replicas
                                        if r.commit_index >= self.commit_index),
                   log_is_canonical=all(r.last_log_index <= len(self.log)
                                        for r in self.replicas))
        self.timeline.append(row)

    def election(self, candidate):
        self.epoch += 1
        candidate.epoch = self.epoch
        candidate.role, candidate.voted_for = "candidate", candidate.rid
        votes = 1
        for r in self.up():
            if r.rid != candidate.rid and r.epoch <= self.epoch:
                r.epoch = self.epoch
                r.voted_for = candidate.rid
                votes += 1
        if votes >= QUORUM:
            candidate.role = "leader"
            self.leader = candidate.rid
            for r in self.up():
                r.heartbeat(candidate.rid)
            self._ev("leader-elected", f"candidate=r{candidate.rid}, votes={votes}, quorum={QUORUM}")
        else:
            self._ev("election-failed", f"candidate=r{candidate.rid}, votes={votes}, quorum={QUORUM}")
        return self.leader

    def replicate(self, value):
        if self.leader is None:
            return None
        leader = self.replicas[self.leader]
        entry = {"epoch": self.epoch, "index": leader.last_log_index + 1,
                 "value": value, "leader": self.leader}
        leader.log.append(entry)
        acks = 1
        for r in self.up():
            if r.rid != leader.rid:
                if r.append_entries(self.epoch, self.leader, [entry], self.commit_index):
                    acks += 1
        if acks >= QUORUM:
            self.log.append(entry)
            self.commit_index = entry["index"]
            for r in self.up():
                if r.last_log_index >= self.commit_index:
                    r.commit_index = self.commit_index
        return dict(index=entry["index"], acks=acks, committed=acks >= QUORUM)

    def apply_all(self):
        for r in self.up():
            r.apply()
        self.applied_index = (self.replicas[self.leader].applied_index
                              if self.leader is not None else 0)

    def replica_state(self):
        return pd.DataFrame([dict(
            replica=f"r{r.rid}", up=r.up, role=r.role, epoch=r.epoch,
            leader_belief=None if r.leader is None else f"r{r.leader}",
            log_last_index=r.last_log_index,
            commit_index=r.commit_index, applied_index=r.applied_index,
            log_lag_vs_canonical=len(self.log) - r.last_log_index,
            truncations=r.truncations) for r in self.replicas])


cl = LedgerClusterV2()
cl.snapshot("bootstrap")
cl.election(cl.replicas[0]);                  cl.snapshot("epoch1-elected")
for i in range(1, 9): cl.replicate(f"txn-{i:02d}")
cl.apply_all();                               cl.snapshot("after-8-writes")

cl.replicas[0].up = False                     # crash leader
cl.leader = None
cl.replicas[3].log = list(cl.log)             # r3 up-to-date, wins
cl.election(cl.replicas[3]);                  cl.snapshot("epoch2-elected")
for i in range(9, 13): cl.replicate(f"txn-{i:02d}")
cl.apply_all();                               cl.snapshot("after-12-writes")

cl.replicas[0].up = True                      # r0 returns and resyncs
cl.replicas[0].append_entries(cl.epoch, cl.leader, cl.log, cl.commit_index)
cl.replicas[0].apply();                       cl.snapshot("r0-resynced")
print("r0 truncations during resync:", cl.replicas[0].truncations)

# now a genuinely uncommitted tail: put 3 followers down, replicate, then snapshot
for r in (cl.replicas[1], cl.replicas[2], cl.replicas[4]):
    r.up = False
cl.replicate("txn-13-uncommitted")
cl.snapshot("uncommitted-tail")
for r in (cl.replicas[1], cl.replicas[2], cl.replicas[4]):
    r.up = True

print("=== STATE TIMELINE ===")
display(pd.DataFrame(cl.timeline))

print("\n=== PER-REPLICA STATE (final phase) ===")
display(cl.replica_state())

print("\n=== EPOCH / LEADER EVENTS ===")
display(pd.DataFrame(cl.events))

tl = pd.DataFrame(cl.timeline)
checks = pd.DataFrame([
    ("commit_index <= log_last_index",
     (tl.commit_index <= tl.log_last_index).all()),
    ("applied_index <= commit_index",
     (tl.applied_index <= tl.commit_index).all()),
    ("no replica log exceeds canonical log",
     tl.log_is_canonical.all(), tl.log_is_canonical.tolist()),
    ("epoch monotonic non-decreasing",
     (tl.epoch.diff().dropna() >= 0).all()),
    ("quorum of replicas at commit_index, every phase",
     (tl.quorum_at_commit >= tl.quorum_size).all()),
    ("uncommitted tail never enters canonical commit_index",
     tl.commit_index.max() == 13 and len(cl.log) == 14,
     f"canonical log={len(cl.log)}, commit_index={tl.commit_index.max()}"),
], columns=["check", "passed", "detail"])
display(checks)
